create_cygrpc_channel: create a cygrpc Channel connected to localhost:54321 with no credentials
run_connectivity_loop: run a connectivity check loop that watches channel state 100 times
test_single_channel_connectivity: test single channel connectivity by creating, looping, and closing a cygrpc Channel
test_parallel_channel_connectivity: test multiple channels in parallel by running create-loop-destroy across concurrent threads
test_negative_deadline_connectivity: test that a negative deadline on watch_connectivity_state does not trigger SIGABRT
